newsitem.title: UK: CSC computer handling system for early 1998.
newsitem.headline: CSC computer handling system for early 1998.

text.p: Airfreight handler, Cargo Service Center said it plans to introduce a computer handling system to boost efficiency and worldwide customer service levels in early 1998.

Development of the new CASCADE (CArgo Service Center Automated Data Exchange)system is due to be complete by September or October with the time between then and next year used for final adjustments and its installation in over 70 cargo stations worldwide, a CSC spokesman said.
CASCADE's software has largely been developed by Indian-based companies and has already completed tests in Bombay. Further tests are underway in Amsterdam and Montreal, he added.
It is expected to be tested in the UK early next year when it will be installed in CSC's Heathrow warehouse, a company statement added.

This said that CASCADE enables CSC to monitor and control air cargo movements and automatically keeps relevant parties informed on the status of individual shipments using International Air Transport Association (IATA)standard electronic interchange (EDI) messaging.
It added CASCADE can communicate with the existing airline systems meaning that CSC will no longer have to install and use each client airline's own automated handling system.

"Not only will CASCADE dramatically increase the quality and speed of cargo handling, the withdrawal of airline-owned terminals from CSC warehouses will lead to reduced costs for the carriers as they will no longer need to invest in their own systems," CSC's Regional Project Manager, Jim Mason said.

The statement said the Windows-based system can store and download all airline client data, saving time and reducing the scope for error in documentation preparation while a full range of documents can be prepared with the system, including air waybills, cargo manifests and customs declaration forms.
CSC is part of the KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV group. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
